# WO-123: Site-wide "available now" claims follow release.yaml (test only)
Status: open (local start: tools/copilot.sh start WO-123)
Vendor: copilot
Agent: test-quality
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (CLAUDE_TO_COPILOT.md; check-ins via tools/copilot.sh checkin)
Assigned to: Malik Johnson (Copilot test-quality), local Copilot CLI
Source: Copilot CLI proposal 3 (release-site consistency), accepted in CLAUDE-P003

## Goal
ROADMAP section 6: only what is in a published release (GitHub release + `site_src/data/release.yaml`) is "available".
Existing tests pin single pages (tests/test_web_download_metadata.py, tests/test_web_developer_release_status.py,
tests/test_web_v03_roadmap.py). Add one site-wide guard over the BUILT site (web/dist): every page that shows an
"Available now" badge or a version number states the version from release.yaml, never an older or newer one, and no
page shows a download button or "available" wording when release.yaml has no published version (test the current
branch only, unless an existing harness can exercise the unreleased branch without editing data).

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- New tests pass offline against a fresh build (`cd web && pnpm build`); read the version from release.yaml, never hard-code it.
- Do not duplicate the existing per-page assertions; cover pages they don't.
- A real mismatch: strict xfail on that case only, with a reason, reported in VENDOR_STATUS.md.
- `ruff check tests` passes. No network, no new dependencies.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- tests/test_web_release_claims.py (new)
- VENDOR_STATUS.md

## Out of scope / do not touch
site_src/data/release.yaml, web/, every existing test.

## Check-in plan
VENDOR_STATUS.md when done; Grace summarises in COPILOT_TO_CLAUDE.md.
